description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasController class, specifically testing the parsing of snapshot parameters such as format, quality, and maxWidth.

classes.name: CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the parseSnapshotParams function of CanvasController.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsDefaultsToJpeg
methods.description: Tests that the default snapshot format is JPEG when no parameters are provided.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesPng
methods.description: Tests parsing of a PNG format snapshot with a specified maxWidth.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesJpegAliases
methods.description: Tests that different string aliases ('jpeg', 'jpg') are correctly interpreted as JPEG format.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsClampsQuality
methods.description: Tests that the 'quality' parameter is clamped to expected bounds when out of range.
